what: Observation: after the 'hold and release for queued items' job landed (13 Nov ~10:10 UTC), the drain rebuilt itself but the new build still reported itself as built from a48031ceef1e, refused to start ('stale build ... run ./setup.sh') and the batch stopped. A manual drain-restart rebuilt from a5f57002c326 and started cleanly. The self-rebuild-and-continue step can leave a stale binary.
why: Seen in the drain log; batch was down until I restarted it.
